properties.description: Attractive three bedroom semi-detached family home situated in a popular residential location. The property benefits from a well-maintained rear garden, off-street parking, and is within walking distance of local amenities and transport links. The accommodation comprises a welcoming entrance hall, spacious living room with feature fireplace, modern fitted kitchen, three well-proportioned bedrooms, and a family bathroom. An ideal family home in a sought-after area.
properties.location: Petts Wood Road, Petts Wood, Orpington BR5

properties.description: Presented in excellent decorative order throughout, this charming two bedroom flat offers modern living in a convenient location. The property features a bright and airy open-plan living area, contemporary kitchen with integrated appliances, two double bedrooms, and a stylish bathroom. The flat benefits from double glazing, gas central heating, and is located close to shops, restaurants, and excellent transport connections.

Stunning four bedroom detached family home in an exclusive residential area. This impressive property boasts a large driveway, double garage, and beautifully landscaped gardens. The interior features a grand entrance hall, spacious reception rooms, modern kitchen with island, utility room, four generous bedrooms with en-suite to master, and a family bathroom. Perfect for families seeking space and luxury.

Modern one bedroom apartment ideal for first-time buyers or investors. The property is located in a well-maintained development and features an open-plan living space, fitted kitchen, double bedroom, and contemporary bathroom. Benefits include allocated parking, lift access, and proximity to local shops and transport. A great opportunity in a popular area.

Magnificent five bedroom Victorian family home with original period features. This character property offers spacious accommodation including three reception rooms, large kitchen/breakfast room, five bedrooms, three bathrooms, and a cellar. The property sits on a generous plot with mature gardens, summer house, and off-street parking for multiple vehicles. A rare opportunity to acquire a piece of local history.

Spacious three bedroom penthouse apartment with stunning views. This luxury property features a private balcony, high-specification finish throughout, and premium fixtures and fittings. The accommodation includes a large open-plan living area, modern kitchen with granite worktops, three double bedrooms, two bathrooms, and ample storage. Located in a prestigious development with concierge service.

Charming two bedroom terraced cottage with character features. This delightful property offers a cosy living room with log burner, fitted kitchen, two bedrooms, and a family bathroom. The property benefits from a private rear garden, off-street parking, and is located in a quiet residential street. Ideal for couples or small families looking for a character home.

Modern one bedroom apartment with stunning views. This luxurious property features a private balcony, high-specification finish throughout, and premium fixtures and fittings. The accommodation includes a large open-plan living area, modern kitchen with granite worktops, one double bedroom, and a contemporary bathroom. Located in a prestigious development with concierge service.
